title: minecraft crafting improvements
description: a data pack that adds a new icy biome, and crafting recipes for saddle, iron horse armor, elytra, enchanted golden apple, and reinforced deepslate.
body:
if  you want to have a source of uncraftable items, i added new crafting recipes, which are unlocked by advancements.
adds crafting recipe for elytra, enchanted golden apple, saddle, iron horse armor, and adds smithing recipe for reinforced deepslate (deepslate+rib trim+bone)
adds a new snowy biome with polar bears and evokers
